answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in ferrous, expire in lagoon, and tide lists each expiry. Someone running 92 aliases therefore needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4527 identities would post 1059 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
